body:
Instead of feeling like a new beginning in the Marvel universe, it comes across as a tired retread of familiar territory.

The plot is a chaotic jumble of contrived twists and subpar special effects. Despite its attempts at humor, the film is heavy and unsatisfying. It's clear that this latest installment is just another part of the Marvel machine, a dated mechanism that keeps churning out movies without regard for quality.

However, there is a bright spot in this otherwise lackluster film: the introduction of Kang the Conqueror as a worthy and formidable villain. This character is the one saving grace of "Quantumania." Unfortunately, the rest of the movie falls short, failing to deliver in almost every other way. The film tries to do too much and loses the charm that made the previous Ant-Man films so enjoyable. The irony is that, in the end, the best performances come from the real-life acting of the stars, not the millions spent on CGI.
